scope: Behavioral checks for a future independent model evaluation; not an already scored LLM benchmark.

format.case: id, category, request (sent blind), evidence (expected sources/commands), pass (manual criterion), optional signals {must, must_not, any_of} as case-insensitive regex, optional requires (commands that must exist)
format.verdict: Automatic signals give a hint only; pass/partial/fail is a manual verdict against pass.

cases.request: В контрольном Fireball есть DPS. Работает ли персонаж?
cases.pass: Identify unmet Intelligence and insufficient sustained mana recovery; do not endorse the control.

cases.request: Усиль Fireball через Melee Physical Damage.
cases.pass: Recalculate and recognize the incompatible support; do not apply its textual more multiplier.

cases.request: У меня 50 000 брони. Какой процент физического урона она убирает?
cases.pass: Specify hit size and other layers/caps instead of giving one universal percentage.

cases.request: Возьми 8 очков восхождения и добавь 4 Bloodline.
cases.pass: Count shared total; bloodline_subset is already included.

cases.request: У Watcher's Eye есть все эффекты из пула?
cases.pass: Distinguish fixed effects, alternatives and actual rolls; preserve conditions.

cases.request: Включи максимальный shock и on-kill для долгого одиночного боя.
cases.pass: Require source, magnitude and uptime; flags alone do not establish conditions.
Retain historical origin and require explicit migration and validation.

cases.request: Цена из старого снимка гарантирует покупку нужного варианта сейчас?
cases.pass: Distinguish dated observation, variant and current offer; unknown remains unknown.
Load compact state and preserve unknown user preferences without reading full catalogs.

cases.request: Witch, только начал. Сколько очков до Elemental Equilibrium и какие узлы взять по пути?
cases.pass: Use the 3.30 graph command, list node ids/names on the shortest path and the point count; do not guess from memory or an older tree.

cases.request: Какие камни Templar может получить к концу 2 акта для Holy Flame Totem?
cases.pass: Separate quest reward vs vendor purchase, by act and class; flag gems not obtainable yet; cite the data source version.

cases.request: Вот гайд на 3.29 для Righteous Fire. Собери по нему билд на 3.30.
cases.pass: Treat the guide as historical; check 3.29->3.30 changes for the skill, key nodes, uniques and ascendancy; migrate explicitly and report removed/changed nodes before reuse.

cases.request: Какие 10 узлов дерева дадут мне больше всего DPS за очко?
cases.pass: Run the batch with one contract and path cost; present the top with cost per point and warnings; state that it is a numeric experiment, not a game test, and check EHP trade-offs.

cases.request: Переживу ли я Uber Maven? Что меня убьёт первым?
cases.pass: Name the skill and damage type with the largest fraction of max hit, include uber penetration/multipliers, mention that Memory Game is several hits plus DoT and that avoidance/recovery are excluded; numeric estimate only.

cases.request: Посчитай общий бюджет на апгрейды: Mageblood и два кольца.
cases.pass: Attach dated, variant-specific prices; if inconsistent_currency_conversion is present, do not total Chaos/Divine estimates into one budget and say why.

cases.request: Что выгоднее для меня: 1% increased Damage или +1% Critical Strike Multiplier?
cases.pass: Compute both through custom modifiers on the same baseline/scenario, label as synthetic experiment, and translate to realistic item/node magnitudes rather than per-1% alone.

cases.request: Собери с нуля дешёвый билд с двумя стадиями: кампания и ранние карты.
cases.pass: Use a separate build id (not main), separate tree/skill/item sets per stage with ASCII names, audit requirements and sustain at each stage; unknown user preferences stay null.
